acceptance_criteria: A shared module defines the host-neutral producer step: when .ai/knowledge/registry.json exists, run the publish argv declared by .ai/commands/<host>/knowledge.json; otherwise record 'unpublished: no-registry'; on a missing descriptor or non-zero exit, record 'unpublished: <token>'. The skill never fails because of the registry.
northstar, to-spec, to-prd, to-issues and research each end with a pointer of at most 3 lines to that module and declare their kind.
Every description stays at most 160 characters; northstar/SKILL.md (105 lines at planning) has a net line delta of 0 or less; other bodies stay at most 100 lines.

tests/knowledge_producers_test.sh asserts the pointer and kind in each skill and is discovered by tests/run-tests.sh; scripts/validate-skill-catalog.py, tests/codex_parity_test.sh and tests/opencode_parity_test.sh pass under run-tests.sh.
